tests.name: sensor-config-present
tests.description: do-harness.toml defines the workspace sensor pack

tests.name: six-core-sensors
tests.description: fmt, check, clippy, test, deny, loc sensors are configured
tests.exec: for s in fmt check clippy test deny loc; do rg -q "name = \"$s\"" do-harness.toml || exit 1; done

tests.name: loc-sensor-script
tests.description: check-loc.sh sensor script exists and is executable

tests.name: workflow-step-ten
tests.description: AGENTS.md runs canonical do-harness verify --set verification --strict --record

tests.name: dev-harness-section
tests.description: AGENTS.md documents the Dev Harness (do-harness) section

tests.name: hook-ownership-guard
tests.description: Documents that pre-commit framework owns .git/hooks (no do-harness hook install)
tests.exec: rg -q 'Do NOT run \`?do-harness hook install' AGENTS.md

tests.name: harness-pin-single-source
tests.description: the harness version pin has one tracked source and the routing doc points at it

tests.name: compat-probes-documented-and-runnable
tests.description: the skill names both CLI-contract probes and the scripts it names exist
tests.exec: rg -q 'check-do-harness-compat\.sh' .agents/skills/harness/SKILL.md && rg -q 'check-do-harness-doctrine\.sh' .agents/skills/harness/SKILL.md && test -x scripts/check-do-harness-compat.sh && test -x scripts/check-do-harness-doctrine.sh

tests.name: compat-probes-are-sensors
tests.description: both probes are declared sensors, so they run in the completion contract rather than only as manual commands
tests.exec: rg -q '^name = "harness-compat"' do-harness.toml && rg -q '^name = "harness-doctrine"' do-harness.toml && rg -q 'harness-compat' AGENTS.md && rg -q 'harness-doctrine' AGENTS.md
